title: Circle Island Tour with Snorkeling
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape from Waikiki and see the beautiful North Shore of Oahu! Our late riser tour leaves at 9am and goes on a reverse route from the usual tour companies! This allows us to beat most other groups to each spot and deliver a better experience!

The tour includes: water, snacks, lunch, snorkel at turtle bay, and transportation in a comfortable vehicle driven by a local native-hawaiian guide. A great experience anyone can enjoy with plenty of spots for shopping, eating, and beach relaxation!

- Scenic route around Oʻahu’s eastern coast and North Shore
- Convenient hotel pickup and roundtrip transportation included
- 6-8 hour duration allows for ample sightseeing and food stops
